description:
## What

Introduce a single read primitive on `OctoPi.Coder.SessionStore`:

```elixir
@spec path(server, leaf_id :: binary | :leaf, opts) :: [Entry.t()]
# opts:
#   :to — :root (default) | :latest_compaction | binary_id
```

Reimplement on top of it:

- `get_branch/1,2` → `path(server, leaf, to: :root)`
- `find_common_ancestor/3` → two `path/2` calls + set intersection
- `collect_entries_for_branch_summary/3` → `path/2` slice + ancestor-found drop_while

## Why

Both branch-switch and compaction need exactly this operation: "linear slice from a leaf walking toward root, optionally stopping at an anchor." Today they share a derivation (parent_id walk in SessionManager) but not an API. Collapsing onto `path/2` makes the store's read surface one function with one well-defined contract.

## Files

- `apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/session_store.ex` — `path/2` + reimplementations
- `apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/session_manager.ex` — removes the now-redundant walking logic (or keeps it as a private helper)
- callers — should not need updates if opi-1.1 already routed everything through the store API; pure internal refactor

## Out of scope

- Using `to: :latest_compaction` to unify post-compact reset — that's opi-1.3.

## Done when

- `path/2` exists with all three `:to` modes.
- The other read functions are 1- to 3-line wrappers.
- Tests covering all three `:to` modes (including walking past a compaction without it stopping when `:to` is `:root`).
title: Add Store.path/2 primitive; collapse reads onto it
